Perspective.InputOutsidePlane.zh: 当前位置不在画布可绘制区域内。
Perspective.InputOutsidePlane.en: This position is outside the drawable canvas plane.

Perspective.SnapshotOutsidePlane.zh: 截图区域跨过透视边界，请调整选区或画布透视。
Perspective.SnapshotOutsidePlane.en: The snapshot crosses the perspective boundary. Adjust the selection or canvas perspective.

Perspective.InspectorPlaneBounds.zh: 截图的尺寸表示画布平面上的外框尺寸。
Perspective.InspectorPlaneBounds.en: Snapshot dimensions describe its bounds on the canvas plane.
